svg.title: Kramers and flat minima
svg.desc: Left: a potential with a narrow, sharp well and a wide, flat well at the same depth, and its Gibbs density at two temperatures; the share in the sharp well stays near 0.09 at both. Right: that share against temperature is flat when the minima have equal loss and changes only when the flat minimum is lifted, so temperature trades loss against volume and does not by itself penalise curvature.
svg.text: Proposition 2.8: temperature does not tilt the flat/sharp preference
Two minima of equal loss, curvature 100 and 1. Exact 1-D Langevin (dX = −V′dt + √(2T) dW).
V(w), and Gibbs densities scaled to peak 1.5
